overall_summary: Analysis of the deduplicated performance metrics shows clear viewer preference for extreme cosmic phenomena, high-stakes hypothetical scenarios ('What If'), and biological anomalies with high view-velocity and engagement rates (likes/views). Space-related 'What If' scenarios and bizarre planetary conditions (e.g., diamond planets, liquid-metal rain, extreme density or darkness) consistently generate the highest view counts and engagement ratios, whereas human psychology and localized animal facts yield lower relative traction.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'What If You Fell Into a Liquid Diamond Planet?' (1,029 views, 38 likes) and 'What If You Fell Into the Planet of Burning Ice?' (972 views, 18 likes) outperform standard static facts by combining tactile spatial dread with high-value planetary anomalies.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on cinematic, immersive space scenarios where the viewer is placed directly into a bizarre cosmic environment.

winning_patterns.evidence: Titles featuring extreme planetary traits like 'The Planet Darker Than Coal' (1,030 views, 36 likes) and 'Venus Has a Day Longer Than Its Year' (981 views, 21 likes) show rapid velocity and strong engagement.
winning_patterns.action: Produce more short-form pieces focusing on lesser-known, physics-defying celestial bodies and astronomical anomalies.

weak_patterns.evidence: Topics like 'Your Brain Can Create Fake Memories' (5-53 views) and psychological tricks for songs stuck in the head (71 views) demonstrate low impression-to-view conversion and minimal engagement.
weak_patterns.action: Deprioritize standalone human psychology and memory hacks unless tied to a high-concept sci-fi or thriller narrative.

weak_patterns.evidence: Basic animal facts like 'Octopuses Have THREE Hearts' (118-363 views) underperform compared to deep-space or high-stakes survival content, showing lower viewer retention potential.
weak_patterns.action: Shift animal content away from simple trivia toward cinematic animal survival or prehistoric apex predator comparisons.
